originalGenerationRecord.exactPromptContent:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full-body game enemy source drawing for a later native-shape adapter, not runtime delivery.
Create Genshin Impact's CRYO ABYSS MAGE, faithfully recognizable from identity references 1 and 2. Image 1 (HoYoLAB in-game full body) and image 2 (clear game-render cutout) supply identity ONLY: small floating nonhuman body, two pale ice-blue rabbit-ear hood projections, rounded BLACK navy face with TWO bright mint-cyan glowing eyes framed by white hood rim, thick pale ice-blue/white layered fluffy collar, dark midnight blue robe and sleeves with broad white/silver icy angular hems and real snowflake-like panel motifs, tiny dark gloved hands and boots with light ankle bands, and blue crooked staff crowned by open dark blue icy prongs supporting a bright pale blue SIX-ARM SNOWFLAKE. Image 3 (our red Pyro Mage drawing) supplies painterly finish and broad material-plane style ONLY, NOT colors, staff, costume or pose.
Make a NEW compact left-facing three-quarter hovering battle pose: staff held upright leaning gently toward left, free hand extended toward left, two short dangling legs readable; use a different pose than both game reference and Pyro sample. Preserve actual Cryo hood, dark face, eyes, icy fur collar, snowy robe patterns and snowflake staff rather than a Pyro recolor or a Hydro white mask. Mature hand-painted game illustration, broad smooth readable 3-4 value masses per material, modest collar facets and large robe patterns, not tiny ornamental filigree, not low-poly triangulation. Designed to read at 106px and 127px full contain and later approximately600 native shapes. Identity above invention. Full figure AND entire staff inside a square canvas with 7-8 percent clear transparent padding on EVERY side. Center balanced silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha background. No shield bubble, magic effects, particles, frost cloud, aura, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, UI, watermark, frame, extra characters or props. Do not retain any reference background. Source art only; no runtime or approval claim.
